title: Joint Arrangements
summary: Governs accounting for joint arrangements, classifying them as joint operations or joint ventures, substantially converged with IFRS 11.

bannerNotice.title: Substantially converged with IAS/IFRS
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 111 reproduces IFRS 11's joint operation vs joint venture classification almost exactly. Its most common Indian application is in infrastructure and construction consortium arrangements, and oil/gas exploration joint ventures.
